messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 SLO breach detected for inference-gateway (us-west-2) at 2024-11-02T14:01:30Z. p99 = 1.82s (>1.5s). Elevated streaming stalls and tail latency observed. Auto-escalating to #incidents.

oncall-sre: acked — paging oncall. I'm on it, will start triage.

ashwin: seeing a big jump in config-fetch latency from control-plane: most requests to config-service are ~350ms -> 1.1s, and auth token fetch p99 spiking too. Could be correlated.

maria: any customer impact yet? dashboards show a small bump in 5 customers with degraded streaming (timeouts on tail tokens). Not widespread but noticeable.

kevin: quick numbers from dashboards: 
```
inference-gateway p95: 420ms
inference-gateway p99: 1.82s
streaming stall rate: +9% over baseline
config-service p99: 1.05s (baseline 120ms)
auth-token-store p99: 800ms -> 1.4s
```

olivia: logs show retries against auth-service with 429s during the surge. Might be rate-limiter kicking in + featureflag propagation calls causing fanout.

oncall-sre: good, priority list: 1) credit impact/customer-facing triage 2) reduce immediate p99 3) root cause (auth / config fetch / ff rollouts).

sam: I'm seeing a recent feature flag rollout for the new batching optimizer (ff: optimizer-v2) that hits config-service for variant decisions per request. Could be fanout hotspot. Rollout started ~13:55 UTC.

ashwin: that matches timing. If each request triggers a config fetch + token validation, tail will balloon. Suggest temp rollback or short-circuit the config fetch.

maria: customer-impact note for postmortem: 5 customers with intermittent stream stalls, one support ticket opened (acct: acme-inc). No data loss; retries degrade UX.

oncall-sre: mitigation plan: 1) pause optimizer-v2 rollout (kevin) 2) enable local short-circuit cache for config decisions (ashwin) 3) increase auth-token-store rate limits + backpressure (olivia) 4) put automatic fallback to cached model variant (sam) — do in that order and report.

kevin: paused rollout via FF service: `PATCH /flags/optimizer-v2 {"status":"paused"}` — response 200. Confirmed propagation took ~10s to control plane.

ashwin: applying short-circuit TTL=30s for config-cache on gateways (hotfix): `env VAR_CONFIG_CACHE_TTL=30 && rollout hotpatch` — pushing now.

olivia: auth team temporarily raised token-store limit for us-west-2 to allow smoothing and added short backoff handler to reduce 429 storms. Patch applied.

sam: fallback enabled: gateway will use last-known variant if config fetch > 300ms. Deployed. Monitoring.

kevin: metrics after mitigations (14:08 UTC): p99 down to 1.12s, streaming stalls down to +3%. still above SLO but trending.

maria: sending customer comms to support with note: degraded streaming for subset of customers, working on mitigation, ETA 30m.

oncall-sre: good. continue monitoring for 30m window. If p99 < 0.9s and stalls <1% we can close page and open follow-up RFC for config-service caching and ff rollout gating.

ashwin: grabbing config-service traces to investigate root cause (fanout + cold caches). Will attach spans to incident doc.

olivia: also collecting auth-token-store histograms and rate-limiter logs. Suspicious pattern: bursty retries from single edge cluster causing token-store hot-keys.

sam: note for follow-up: change ff rollout to server-side sampling (reduce per-request fetch) and add eval set to detect p99 regressions before 50% traffic.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied. p99 decreasing. Next update in 15m or on-call escalation.

oncall-sre: handing off to onshifts team for live monitoring — I'm marked OOO in 20m. @ashwin you'll take lead for postmortem and timeline.

ashwin: got it, I'll draft timeline and customer impact. Will start with logs/traces from 13:50-14:15 UTC.

maria: thanks everyone — tracking action items: roll back ff (kevin), short-circuit cache (ashwin), auth rate bump (olivia), gateway fallback (sam), support comms (maria).

kevin: after-action note: FF service should include a low-cost canary mode for config hotpaths; raising ticket now.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: p99 back to 0.88s (14:23 UTC). Closing page. Please link follow-up RFCs and postmortem when ready. :white_check_mark:
